evidence.summary: Zhejiang University of Science and Technology, announcing a cooperation agreement with the PAP NCO School (武警士官学校) in May 2017, described it as Zhejiang’s only military academy and a People’s Armed Police institution of higher education that trains PAP command cadres; the agreement covers resource sharing and co-operation in teaching, research and training.

A 2014 Zhejiang tender notice for a new campus in Fuyang for the PAP Hangzhou NCO School shows the project approved and supervised by the PAP’s logistics department; NDU notes that the PAP has answered to the Central Military Commission alone since the 2017–2018 reforms.
